Johns' Boys Welsh Male Voice Choir


To book tickets, set ticket reminder, or add to waitlist click BOOK NOW button above

Scroll down for info on reserving a pre-show meal with Margins Cafe.
 

Experience the unmistakable sound of Johns’ Boys Welsh Male Voice Choir in the extraordinary surroundings of London’s iconic Union Chapel.

Johns' Boys made history as the first and only British male voice choir to win the prestigious Pavarotti Choir of the World title at the Llangollen International Musical Eisteddfod.

Since then, the choir have appeared on Britain's Got Talent, The Royal Variety Performance, BBC's Last Night of the Proms and Netflix's Stay Close, captivating audiences with their rich harmonies, musical excellence and distinctive Welsh sound.

Renowned for combining the proud tradition of Welsh male voice singing with fresh, contemporary arrangements, Johns' Boys present a programme of soaring harmonies, beloved hymns, traditional Welsh favourites and modern classics.

Every performance is delivered with passion, warmth and exceptional musicianship, creating an unforgettable concert experience that has captivated audiences across the UK and beyond.

Join Johns' Boys for a very special London concert in one of the capital's most atmospheric venues, celebrating the very best of Welsh choral music.

With recent concerts selling out across the UK, early booking is strongly recommended.

Book For A Pre-Show Dinner

Make your dinner reservation to eat at our Margins Cafe before the show!

You must have a general admission ticket for the show to gain entry for dinner.

Doors will open for early dinner ticket holders at 18:00.

The Margins Cafe serves delicious, freshly prepared food at gigs and events.  All profits go towards The Margins Project, based here at the Chapel which works with people who face issues of homelessness and crisis.

More Information:

For Accessibility, please click here.

The venue is seating only. All seats are unreserved and are taken on a first come first serve basis. Please arrive early before event door times if you have preferred seats. Due to the nature of our venue, please be prepared to queue for entry.

The venue is fully accessible, with use of ramps and the upstairs bar is accessible with use of a platform lift. Please email [email protected] with any specific accessibility requirements, that we should be aware of, as soon as you purchase your ticket as requests are dealt with on a first come, first serve basis.

The bar is located on the first floor of the venue and will be open from the stated door time and remain open after the show.

Alcohol consumption will be limited to the bar area only, it is not permitted to take alcohol to the main chapel space.  An array of soft drinks and snacks will also be available and are permitted in the main space - please note the Union Chapel bar and kiosk accept card payment only. Strictly no food or drink may be brought from outside into the venue. Water bottles must be emptied before entering the venue, with refilling stations available inside.

Seats for Margin's Cafe Early Dinners can be reserved via the links above. Margin's Cafe accepts both cash and card. If you have any queries about Margins Cafe, please contact [email protected]
